text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Japan Cup. Meisho Doto nervously announces herself as a rival to T.M. Opera O.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O puts on a shocked front, but she inwardly welcomes the change and gladly accepts Doto's challenge.
